transcript_src: Hi, I bought the Glow face wash last week and my skin broke out in rashes. I want a refund. The agent apologised, issued a refund and asked me to stop using it.
transcript_en: Hi, I bought the Glow face wash last week and my skin broke out in rashes. I want a refund. The agent apologised, issued a refund and asked me to stop using it.
summary: Customer reported a skin reaction to the face wash and received a refund.

transcript_src: नमस्ते, मेरा ऑर्डर दस दिन से नहीं आया है। ट्रैकिंग में कुछ अपडेट नहीं दिख रहा। मुझे जल्दी चाहिए।
transcript_en: Hello, my order has not arrived for ten days. The tracking shows no update. I need it soon.
summary: Customer's shampoo order is ten days late with no tracking update; unresolved.

transcript_src: I love the new vitamin C serum. Does it come in a bigger bottle? I would happily buy the family pack and maybe the matching moisturiser too.
transcript_en: I love the new vitamin C serum. Does it come in a bigger bottle? I would happily buy the family pack and maybe the matching moisturiser too.
summary: Happy customer asked about a larger serum bottle and showed interest in bundles.

transcript_src: पैकेजिंग बहुत खराब थी, बोतल का ढक्कन टूटा हुआ आया और क्रीम बाहर लीक हो गई।
transcript_en: The packaging was very poor, the bottle cap arrived broken and the cream leaked out.
summary: Face cream arrived leaking from a broken cap; replacement promised but not confirmed.

transcript_src: I was charged twice for the same face wash order. Please reverse one of the payments. Thanks, the agent confirmed the refund will land in three days.
transcript_en: I was charged twice for the same face wash order. Please reverse one of the payments. Thanks, the agent confirmed the refund will land in three days.
summary: Duplicate charge on a face wash order was reversed.

transcript_src: फेस वॉश की खुशबू बहुत तेज़ है, क्या बिना खुशबू वाला वर्शन मिलता है? मुझे प्रोडक्ट पसंद है बस खुशबू नहीं।
transcript_en: The face wash fragrance is very strong, is there a fragrance-free version? I like the product, just not the smell.
summary: Customer likes the face wash but asked for a fragrance-free variant.

transcript_src: The shampoo is great but the pump stopped working after two uses. Can I get a replacement pump or a new bottle?
transcript_en: The shampoo is great but the pump stopped working after two uses. Can I get a replacement pump or a new bottle?
summary: Shampoo pump failed after two uses; replacement bottle sent.

transcript_src: Just calling to say thank you. The sunscreen you recommended worked perfectly on our trip. I will order two more for my family.
transcript_en: Just calling to say thank you. The sunscreen you recommended worked perfectly on our trip. I will order two more for my family.
summary: Customer praised the sunscreen and plans to order more for family.

transcript_src: मैंने रिफंड के लिए पंद्रह दिन पहले आवेदन किया था लेकिन पैसे अब तक नहीं आए। यह बहुत परेशान करने वाला है।
transcript_en: I applied for a refund fifteen days ago but the money has not arrived yet. This is very frustrating.
summary: Refund requested fifteen days ago is still pending; customer frustrated.

transcript_src: Your delivery partner left the parcel with a neighbour without telling me. The face wash was fine but the delivery experience was poor.
transcript_en: Your delivery partner left the parcel with a neighbour without telling me. The face wash was fine but the delivery experience was poor.
summary: Parcel was left with a neighbour; product fine but delivery handling was poor.

transcript_src: मुझे विटामिन सी सीरम बहुत पसंद आया। क्या कोई कॉम्बो ऑफर है जिसमें सीरम और सनस्क्रीन साथ मिले?
transcript_en: I really liked the vitamin C serum. Is there a combo offer that includes the serum and sunscreen together?
summary: Customer liked the serum and asked about a serum plus sunscreen combo.

transcript_src: The face wash I received seems different from the one I bought before. The texture is watery and it does not foam. Is this a fake product?
transcript_en: The face wash I received seems different from the one I bought before. The texture is watery and it does not foam. Is this a fake product?
summary: Customer suspects the face wash is off-spec because of watery texture; case escalated.
